description: Source code for Minidump file writer implementation, part of the Google Breakpad crash reporting system. Contains class definitions, methods for file handling, string copying, memory writing, and platform-specific workarounds.

classes.name: MinidumpFileWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for creating and writing minidump files, managing file operations, string conversions, and memory allocations.

classes.name: UntypedMDRVA
classes.description: Helper class for managing memory ranges within the minidump file writer context.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a file for writing minidump data.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the open file, truncating it to the current position.

methods.name: SetFile
methods.description: Sets an existing file descriptor for writing, disables automatic closing.

methods.name: CopyStringToMDString
methods.description: Copies a wide or narrow string into an MDString structure, converting encoding as needed.

methods.name: WriteStringCore
methods.description: Core function to write a string (wide or narrow) into the minidump, allocating necessary space.

methods.name: WriteMemory
methods.description: Writes a block of memory into the minidump file.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates space in the minidump file for data, expanding the file as needed.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the minidump file at a specified position.
